profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary: Ever since I wrote my first hello world in Javascript I've been obsessed with learning  software development, and  practicing all the latest web development techniques.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked with Automation to create UI and API automated tests for a virtual experience application.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
-Designed and created an appointment booking site for a financial consulting business using HTML, JS, and CSS for speedier onboarding. Increased page loading time and mobile responsiveness by using more efficient hosting platform.
-Improved SEO of a production company website by enhancing its page layout and keyword meta tags.

positions.title: Post Production Intern
positions.description:
Acted as an Assistant Editor; assisting in editing client and internal projects.
Syncing audio and video together.
Repackaging video sequences, codecs and settings for multi platform distribution (FB, IG, etc).
Organize raw footage, graphics, and other assets in server for editors usage.
Exporting and Crosslinking files to Dropbox, Creative Cloud, and Internal server.
Creating Media, Graphics, Video and Pics necessary using Photoshop and Premiere Pro.
Virtual Set Design using Green Screen Videography and Premier Pro.
Basic Animation concepting and implementation using Photoshop.
Creating Rough Cuts for Production as needed.
